title.text: Every Moodle feature, one tap away

mainNote.text: Desktop launcher. The grid button in the top bar opens a panel listing every Moodle feature this person may use, grouped, with a search box and the .* regex switch. Try: type 'grade', switch on .* and type '^(c|b)', or pick a group chip. Items the site has turned off stay listed with the reason, and administrators get a 'Turn on' link. Unbuilt: keyboard arrow navigation between tiles is drawn in the theme, not here.

phoneNote.text: Phone. The same list as a bottom sheet with 48 px rows, so nothing hides at 390 px. Groups fold. Try: tap a group heading to fold it, or search.

pageNote.text: All features page (/theme/material/features.php). Every feature as a card with what it does, where it lives and whether it is on. Left rail jumps to a group and wraps above the cards on phones. Try: the 'Show turned-off features' switch and the search. Context groups ('This course') appear only inside a course.
